$comment: Machine-readable record of what this fork was taken from, and of the boundary
time scripts/upstream-sync.mjs lands upstream work; leave `base` alone - it is a
measurement of the port, not a moving pointer.

modelNote: This repository shares no commit ancestry with upstream. Its root commit is a
different product entirely (802 files, zero blobs in common with any upstream
commit); the OpenPencil tree arrived later, rebranded, at the import commit
below. `git merge-base HEAD upstream/master` therefore resolves to nothing and
upstream work is taken file by file rather than by three-way merge.

base.subject: Merge pull request #644 from open-pencil/fix-i18n-placeholder-baseline
base.measuredBy: blob-hash set intersection between this tree and every upstream first-parent commit; the peak is the base. Path-keyed comparison scores zero here because the port restructured directories, and a name-only diff is dominated by the brand sweep.

excludedReason: Upstream is MIT throughout and ships no separately-licensed directory, so nothing is excluded. The list stays here so a future upstream split has one place to be recorded.

attribution.why: The MIT licence requires upstream's copyright notice to be retained in every copy.
NOTICE is where the derivation is stated in prose; it must keep naming upstream.
